home.title: Your migrations write the API.
home.lead: Omega reads your database schema at boot and publishes REST, OpenAPI and GraphQL from it. This interface consumes the result.

f1.title: Docs follow your migrations
f1.body: Create a table and get its CRUD, its OpenAPI schema and its GraphQL types. Without writing a line.

f2.title: Authentication, complete
f2.body: JWT, single-use revocable refresh tokens, roles, and seven OAuth providers ready to wire.

f3.title: One typed client
f3.body: This interface reads /api/openapi.json. Rename a column and TypeScript tells you what breaks.

f4.title: One binary, no dependency
f4.body: Pure-Go SQLite, Swagger and GraphiQL consoles embedded. The binary stands on its own.
